name: section-8
text: LESSONS LEARNED

name: title-8
text:
Clearer metrics made the story
more trustworthy.
textPreview: Clearer metrics made the story | more trustworthy.

name: lesson-heading-01
text: Match measure to grain

name: lesson-body-01
text: Use MIN/AVG for repeated occupation/task fields; SUM exposure components.
textPreview: Use MIN/AVG for repeated occupation/task fields; SUM exposure components.

name: lesson-heading-02
text: Separate exposure from role

name: lesson-body-02
text: Ask how much AI appears and what it does as separate questions.
textPreview: Ask how much AI appears and what it does as separate questions.

name: lesson-heading-03
text: Choose charts by relationship

name: lesson-body-03
text: Use bars to rank, 100% bars for balance, and heatmaps/scatters for association.
textPreview: Use bars to rank, 100% bars for balance, and heatmaps/scatters for association.

name: lesson-heading-04
text: Make confidence visible

name: lesson-body-04
text: Show exposure, task count, and coverage; label controls; remove nulls; lock semantic colors.
textPreview: Show exposure, task count, and coverage; label controls; remove nulls; lock semantic colors.

name: closing-question-one
text: The better question is not "Will AI replace jobs?"
textPreview: The better question is not "Will AI replace jobs?"

name: closing-question-two
text: It is "How is AI reallocating tasks between humans and machines?"
textPreview: It is "How is AI reallocating tasks between humans and machines?"
